name: data.police.uk (street-level crime and outcomes)
owner: Home Office / police forces of England, Wales and Northern Ireland
gives: area totals of crime by category and month (Metropolitan Police and City of London Police areas)
interface: JSON API (data.police.uk/docs/) and monthly CSV archive.
notes: Area totals only, by month and category: no street, no outcome row, no person. The publisher anonymises the data; location points are approximate (see the page's anonymisation table).
how: Not collected yet. Decision by Dinis, 18 Nov 2026 about 22:20 UTC (PrompTugal__News__Website board/guidance/2026-11-18-london.md): London is the first place beyond Portugal; each UK source goes on the register with its terms read first, then is collected to the pipeline standard.
